transformation: Exact AST declarations: original version ordering, process-table parsing/assessment, attribution types and service uncertainty/version/recovery errors. No process discovery, filesystem probes, credentials, legacy root, service boot/IPC, sync, chat, workflow, approvals or detached launch. New owned-job persistence and bounded event ring intentionally replace host discovery and diagnostic files, rather than claiming legacy execution equivalence.
nativeBoundary: Only RuntimeProcessService.launch accepts an allowlisted adapter ID through injected trusted authorization; public runtimeProcessDefinitions has status/list/events/cancel only. Adapters are trusted direct-child programs and must not spawn descendants. No group signals, stale PID probes, automatic replay or remote listeners.

integration.ddl: runtime-process-store.ts: RUNTIME_PROCESS_DDL (idempotent CREATE TABLE/INDEX; injected database remains caller-owned)
integration.errorAdapter: RuntimeProcessError exposes code and effect (not-committed|unknown); parent may translate to CoreError without losing either field.
integration.shutdown: await service.close({drainMs}) before closing the injected shared database
integration.restart: Trusted exact-owner CAS previousOwnerId required for an unclosed repository. Old QUEUED/RUNNING -> INTERRUPTED; RUNNING effect unknown. No PID signal or replay.
integration.takeoverPrecondition: Trusted caller must fence/stop the old host before takeover; the module never probes host process liveness.
integration.dependencies: Existing node:sqlite, node:child_process, node:crypto, node:path and zod only. No manifest changes.

nativeApi.adapter: {id,executable:absolutePath,cwd?:absolutePath,env?:Record<string,string>,arguments(jsonInput):readonly string[]}; shell:false,detached:false,stdio ignore/pipe/pipe; empty environment by default
nativeApi.launch: launch({actorId,operationId:UUID,adapterId,input:JSON,deadlineMs?}):Promise<RuntimeProcessJob>; durable idempotency key (actorId,operationId) pins canonical input, adapter and deadline
nativeApi.wait: wait(actorId,jobId):Promise<RuntimeProcessJob>; completion only after owned direct child close
nativeApi.cancel: cancel(actorId,jobId):Promise<RuntimeProcessJob>; idempotent intent, use wait for terminal receipt
nativeApi.close: close({drainMs?}={}):Promise<void>; bounded drain, TERM, grace, KILL, direct-child reaping; rejects on unreconciled persistence or reap failure

integration.limits: Hard ceilings: 4 concurrent,32 queued,4096 retained jobs,128 events/job,65536 bytes/stream,16384 input bytes,128 arguments/32768 argument bytes,300000ms deadline,2000ms TERM grace,30000ms shutdown drain. Config may lower only.
limitations: Trusted adapters must not spawn descendants, detach or invoke a shell; no process-tree termination is claimed. Only currently live direct ChildProcess handles are signalled.
No credential inheritance or remote access is provided. Supplying configured executables/cwd/environment and authenticating the actor are trusted host responsibilities.
Output retains the first per-stream byte cap as base64 and counts all excess discarded bytes; event ring metadata has explicit cursor gaps.

Queue deadline starts at durable admission, not during the trusted authorization callback. In-flight authorization is bounded and cannot launch after close; arbitrary user callbacks cannot be forcibly interrupted.
Receipt history is bounded and fails closed at capacity; archival/removal is an explicit trusted host maintenance concern, never automatic receipt eviction or effect replay.
If persistence fails, new effects are blocked and direct children are reaped. close rejects so the host must reconcile unknown receipts via explicit restart recovery.
